subject: math
cluster: Understand congruence and similarity using physical models, transparencies, or geometry software
intro: These problems take two steps or one equation. You may need to combine two angle facts (for example, a transversal angle that feeds a triangle's angle sum), set up and solve a linear equation from congruent or supplementary angle expressions, or find the third angle of each triangle to decide similarity by AA. Name the angle pair correctly before you compute.

items.prompt: Lines $\ell$ and $m$ are parallel and cut by a transversal. A transversal angle measures $63^\circ$. This same $63^\circ$ angle is one angle of a triangle whose second angle is $81^\circ$. Find the third angle of the triangle.

steps: The triangle's three angles sum to $180^\circ$.
Two of the angles are $63^\circ$ and $81^\circ$.

items.prompt: Corresponding angles formed by two parallel lines cut by a transversal are $(3x + 10)^\circ$ and $(5x - 24)^\circ$. Find $x$.

steps: Corresponding angles formed by parallel lines are congruent, so set the expressions equal.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. A pair of co-interior (same-side interior) angles measure $(2x + 30)^\circ$ and $(4x)^\circ$. Find $x$.

steps: Co-interior (same-side interior) angles formed by parallel lines are supplementary, so they sum to $180^\circ$.

items.prompt: In triangle $ABC$, the exterior angle at vertex $C$ measures $128^\circ$. One of the two remote interior angles measures $59^\circ$. Find the other remote interior angle.

steps: By the exterior-angle theorem, the exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.
The other remote interior angle measures $69^\circ$.

items.prompt: Triangle $ABC$ has angles measuring $52^\circ$ and $61^\circ$. Triangle $DEF$ has angles measuring $61^\circ$ and $67^\circ$. Determine whether the two triangles are similar, and explain using the angle measures.
items.answer: Yes, similar by AA. Both triangles have angles $52^\circ, 61^\circ, 67^\circ$.

steps: Find the third angle of triangle $ABC$: $180^\circ - 52^\circ - 61^\circ = 67^\circ$. Its angles are $52^\circ, 61^\circ, 67^\circ$.
Find the third angle of triangle $DEF$: $180^\circ - 61^\circ - 67^\circ = 52^\circ$. Its angles are $61^\circ, 67^\circ, 52^\circ$.
Both triangles have the same three angle measures: $52^\circ, 61^\circ, 67^\circ$.
Since two angles of one triangle equal two angles of the other, the triangles are similar by the AA criterion.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. An alternate interior angle pair is $(7x - 5)^\circ$ and $(4x + 31)^\circ$. Find $x$ and then the measure of each angle.

steps: Alternate interior angles formed by parallel lines are congruent, so set the expressions equal.

items.prompt: A transversal crosses two parallel lines. The alternate exterior angle of a marked angle measures $124^\circ$. That same alternate exterior angle is an exterior angle of a triangle, and one of its two remote interior angles measures $77^\circ$. Find the other remote interior angle.

steps: Alternate exterior angles formed by parallel lines are congruent, so the marked angle is also $124^\circ$, and the exterior angle of the triangle is $124^\circ$.
By the exterior-angle theorem, $124^\circ$ equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.

items.prompt: In a triangle, the three angles measure $(2x)^\circ$, $(3x)^\circ$, and $(4x)^\circ$. Find $x$ and the measure of the largest angle.

steps: The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^\circ$.

items.prompt: Lines $p$ and $q$ are parallel. A transversal forms an angle of $115^\circ$ with line $p$. Find the measure of the co-interior (same-side interior) angle on line $q$, and find the measure of the corresponding angle on line $q$.

steps: Co-interior (same-side interior) angles are supplementary, so they sum to $180^\circ$: $180^\circ - 115^\circ = 65^\circ$.
Corresponding angles are congruent, so the corresponding angle equals $115^\circ$.

items.prompt: An isosceles triangle has a vertex angle of $(4x)^\circ$ and two congruent base angles each measuring $(x + 18)^\circ$. Find $x$ and the vertex angle.

steps: The three angles sum to $180^\circ$. The two base angles are each $(x + 18)^\circ$.

items.prompt: Triangle $GHJ$ has angles measuring $90^\circ$ and $35^\circ$. Triangle $KLM$ has angles measuring $55^\circ$ and $35^\circ$. Are the triangles similar? Justify your answer.
items.answer: Yes, similar by AA. Both triangles have angles $90^\circ, 55^\circ, 35^\circ$.

steps: Third angle of $GHJ$: $180^\circ - 90^\circ - 35^\circ = 55^\circ$. Its angles are $90^\circ, 35^\circ, 55^\circ$.
Third angle of $KLM$: $180^\circ - 55^\circ - 35^\circ = 90^\circ$. Its angles are $55^\circ, 35^\circ, 90^\circ$.
Both triangles have the same three angles: $35^\circ, 55^\circ, 90^\circ$.
Two angles of one triangle match two angles of the other, so the triangles are similar by AA.

items.prompt: A transversal cuts two parallel lines. One alternate interior angle is $58^\circ$. This $58^\circ$ angle is one angle of a triangle whose second angle is $74^\circ$. Find the third angle of the triangle.

steps: Alternate interior angles formed by parallel lines are congruent, so this triangle angle is $58^\circ$.

items.prompt: Vertical angles formed by two intersecting lines are $(6x - 14)^\circ$ and $(4x + 22)^\circ$. Find $x$ and the measure of each angle.

steps: Vertical angles are congruent, so set the expressions equal.

items.prompt: In triangle $PQR$, the exterior angle at vertex $R$ measures $(7x + 5)^\circ$ and the two remote interior angles measure $48^\circ$ and $(3x + 9)^\circ$. Find $x$.

steps: By the exterior-angle theorem, the exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. A pair of alternate exterior angles measure $(5x + 7)^\circ$ and $(8x - 41)^\circ$. Find $x$ and the measure of each angle.

steps: Alternate exterior angles formed by parallel lines are congruent, so set the expressions equal.
